## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` is clean.
- [ ] `pnpm lint` is clean.
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes.
- [ ] If a migration was added, it's been reviewed for RLS and is reversible (or has a documented rollback).
- [ ] No plaintext secrets, tokens, or env values are in the diff (incl. snapshots / fixtures).
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour or env vars changed (`README.md` / `docs/`).
